# harness_platform_idp_integration_type (Data Source)

Data source for an IDP integration type: its kinds, sync modes and mappable fields.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The kinds an integration type syncs and the fields each kind can map.
data "harness_platform_idp_integration_type" "example" {
  type = "ServiceNow"
}

output "kinds" {
  value = data.harness_platform_idp_integration_type.example.kinds[*].kind
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `type` (String) Integration type, e.g. ServiceNow.

### Read-Only

- `allowed_scopes` (List of String)
- `category` (String)
- `connector` (String) required or none.
- `default_field_mappings` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--default_field_mappings))
- `description` (String)
- `display_name` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `kinds` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--kinds))
- `mode` (String)
- `singleton` (Boolean)
